gameDescriptionHtml:
Run your own Shooting Range.

Manage your supplies, rent guns, and sell ammo packs. Expand and upgrade your shop; level up your popularity to get even better equipment. Open various cases and sell the skins you got from them. Join shooting tournaments and much more!

Game Features

  • Manage Your Supplies – You will rent and sell various guns, ammo packs, equipment, and more. Track your inventory and restock when needed to make sure you have them all for the next customer’s order. You can hire a stocker later to help you out!
  • Rent Out Guns & Equipment – Customers are going to ask you for a specific combination of gun, ammo pack, and equipment. Match each of them and collect your money!
  • Open Cases To Get Various Gun Skins – Test your luck with these random cases! Obtain various skins to sell or complete bundles to earn more money. As you level up, you will get more case options to choose from!
  • Sell Skinned Guns In Your Shop – Put a price tag on it, follow market prices, and attract more customers. Hunt down rare skins to get rich quick!
  • Clean Out Used Guns – Rented guns get worn out with time; buy a cleaning station to clean them regularly. Use different sprays to protect them longer. You can later upgrade it for an automated version to save time!
  • Join Shooting Tournaments – If you think you have what it takes, join a shooting race. Compete with various guns and earn some quick money if you win!
  • Place Targets & Upgrade Range Rooms – In the beginning you have very limited space and have to manually maintain your range, but as you upgrade, your range has more space and time-saving features like automated target placement! Customers always want better and are willing to pay more money!
  • Keep Your Shop Clean – Throw your trash out, collect empty shells, and even recycle them to earn money! Upgrade your tools to make it easier.
